name: Robin Rombach

affiliations.role: Research assistant; first author of latent diffusion

bio: Robin Rombach is a co-founder of Black Forest Labs, the company behind the FLUX image models. They are first author of the latent diffusion paper, which underlies Stable Diffusion, written while working in Björn Ommer's group at LMU Munich.
known_for: First author of latent diffusion models
Co-founder of Black Forest Labs and FLUX
